resolution_rules: A path-qualified reference resolves exactly within the immutable procedure library virtual root.
An unqualified name resolves to the unique highest-priority matching catalog entry.
A tie at the highest priority rejects AMBIGUOUS_PROCEDURE_REFERENCE.
Traversal, symlink escape, mutable working-tree input, missing digest, and post-resolution replacement reject before child creation.
The resolved ProcedureCatalogId, LibraryRevision, dependency closure, and BundleDigest are pinned before admission.

cycle_policy.check: Reject when the resolved child identity already appears in the durable ancestor chain.
cycle_policy.effect: No child ExecutionId or capacity reservation is created.

depth_policy.calculation: child Depth equals parent Depth plus one
depth_policy.effect: Reject before admission or child creation.

argument_policy.shape: unique string keys mapped to bounded typed literals
argument_policy.child_binding: copy into the child's durable ARGS container before its first executable safe point

visibility_rule: Visible controls default workspace presentation only. Hidden children remain discoverable to authorized operators in parent-child, audit, recovery, and Master projections.

parent_child_relationship.identity: one ParentChildId binding StartProcId, parent ExecutionId, and child ExecutionId
parent_child_relationship.immutability: parent, child, pinned procedure identity, arguments digest, and mode tuple never change
parent_child_relationship.blocking_success: Child FINISHED settles StartProc success and resumes the parent at its saved successor.
parent_child_relationship.blocking_failure: Child ABORTED or ERROR settles StartProc failure and routes the parent through its declared failure policy without inventing success.
parent_child_relationship.nonblocking_success: StartProc settles success after durable child admission; later child termination does not rewrite that result.
parent_child_relationship.nonblocking_start_failure: Failure before durable child admission settles StartProc failure.
parent_child_relationship.prompt_isolation: A child prompt has its own PromptId and never overwrites a parent prompt or wait.

parent_terminal_policy.blocking_child: Issue one durable child abort request, retain WAITING_CHILD until child cleanup is resolved, then continue parent cleanup.
parent_terminal_policy.nonblocking_child: Do not infer cancellation; apply the pinned propagation policy and record the independent child outcome.

parent_terminal_policy.blocking_child: Supervisor retains the child and reconstructs the parent's WAITING_CHILD relationship.
parent_terminal_policy.nonblocking_child: Child continues under its own ExecutionId and remains linked for inspection.

crash_restart_cases.rule: No StartProc resource or child exists; retry uses a new request unless the original idempotency key later resolves.
Resume pure resolution for the same StartProcId and pinned library revision.
Reconcile admission and create at most one child using StartProcId as the creation key.
Find the existing child and atomically complete or return the same ParentChildId; never create another child.
Restore the parent's saved successor and WAITING_CHILD state, then observe the same child ExecutionId.
Child recovery uses its own checkpoint and identity; parent stays WAITING_CHILD in blocking mode or remains independent in nonblocking mode.
Settle from the immutable child terminal event and resume or fail the parent once.
Return the immutable settlement and linked child identity.
